name: God Knows Your Name
overview: Scripture reveals a profound truth that God intimately knows each believer by name, demonstrating His personal care and sovereign authority over His people. From God's assurance to Moses that He knows him by name and grants grace (Exodus 33:17), to the promises of protection and redemption given to Israel (Isaiah 43:1-2), the Bible emphasizes that God’s knowledge of us is not distant but deeply relational. Believers are called by His name, created for His glory, and assured of His presence and deliverance (Psalms 91:14; Isaiah 43:7), underscoring the security and identity found in being known by the Lord.
